New in Swift Design

One harness. Four kinds.

Demos, decks, documents, and now social posts, from one chat.

Swipe →
frames.css: .f1-frame { height: 100%; padding: 120px 96px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 32px; } .f1-kicker { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); } h1 { font-size: 96px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; } .f1-lead { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--muted); } .f1-swipe { margin-top: 64px; font-size: 32px; color: var(--accent); }
frames.notes: Caption: Swift Design now writes social posts. Ask, pick, edit, export.

frames.html:
Ask, then write

  1. Describe the post.
  2. Answer three short questions.
  3. Pick a candidate.
  4. Edit it from the chat.

frames.css: .f3-frame { height: 100%; padding: 120px 96px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 56px; } h2 { font-size: 72px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; } .f3-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; } .f3-card { padding: 40px; border: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 24px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.3; display: grid; gap: 12px; } .f3-big { font-size: 64px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent); } .f3-cta { margin-top: auto; font-size: 36px; color: var(--muted); }
